## _Overview_

Kleeb's smelting pickaxes, is a small mod which adds 3 tiers of auto smelting pickaxes.

# _Features_

**1. Furnace Pickaxe. (Can mine up to iron).**

**2. Blaze Pickaxe. (Can mine up to diamond).**

**3. Starforged Pickaxe. (Can mine up to netherite).**

More information in patch notes.
